description: Extract the ordered list of translatable segments from a rich-text document. Each contiguous run of visible text together with the inline tags wrapping it becomes one segment; block-level structure is not part of a segment. Leading/trailing line-break tags inside a segment are excluded, an inline tag containing block content is split, and empty inline tags contribute nothing. Each extracted segment is itself a normalized inline string. The output reports how many segments were found and, for each, the normalized segment markup and its attribute map in order.
